coverage.what_this_covers: This stream enumerated LNG carrier and FSRU newbuild deliveries reported Jan-Sep 2026 by sources independent of the backend's own orderbook tracking (yard/owner press releases, naming-ceremony reports, and trade press), across roughly three dozen named vessels surfaced by four parallel research efforts (Korean-yard sweep, Chinese/Russian-yard sweep, a Hanwha Ocean-focused deep dive, a Zvezda-focused deep dive, and a general trade-press sweep), then matched every one of them by IMO or by name+hull against work/dedup_index.json. RESULT: every vessel with independent delivery evidence traced back to an EXISTING backend row -- there are zero true misses (no candidate clusters) in this pass. Three of those rows were found to carry a stale 'on order' status despite solid independent delivery evidence (Sea Energy, Greenergy River, Alcaios I) and are reported as status_findings, not discovery candidates, per the task's finding-type split. A genuine sister-hull misattribution (Yangze LNG 01, IMO 1040693 vs. its sister IMO 1040708) was caught and rejected before being reported, per the never-infer-from-a-sister-ship rule; IMO 1040708 remains correctly un-updated. A NULL RESULT ON TRUE MISSES IS THE FINDING OF THIS PASS, not an absence of effort: every named 2026 delivery lead that could be independently sourced was checked and is already present in the backend. This does NOT rule out: (1) a 2026 delivery that has had zero press/registry/naming coverage anywhere the searches above could reach (i.e., a vessel that is both new-to-us AND unreported -- an unlikely but not impossible combination for a major LNG carrier); (2) deliveries reported only behind the paywalls/blocks listed under not_reachable; (3) deliveries in the final days of the window (through 2026-09-30) not yet covered by any source at the time of this pass; (4) FSRU CONVERSIONS specifically -- LNGT Turkiye (Seatrium/Karpowership, completed 2026-09-23) could not be matched to any backend row under any name spelling tried and has no pre-conversion IMO available to check; this is left for the parallel S3 FSRU/GIIGNL-based reconciliation stream, which is better positioned to resolve conversions than an IMO/name join against newbuild press. Additional non-actionable data-quality notes surfaced along the way (out of S2's scope, flagged for a future data-fill/fix pass): Hull 2579 (Hanwha, IMO 9987445, Maran Gas Maritime, sheet_row 868) remains genuinely unnamed/unresolved with no delivery evidence found under any lead; the Greenergy River owner-label discrepancy (MOL vs. the JV's actual name, Huajing LNG Transport Pte Ltd) noted above; a 'Gamy Vanguard'/'Christy Vanguard' hull-number naming question (IMO 1019668) that is an internal data-consistency question, not resolvable via independent-source research; and Antaios I (IMO 9995739, sheet_row 930) whose backend Delivery year (2026) appears to conflict with CCEC's own Q2-2026 earnings-call guidance (now targeting Q1 2027) -- Status 'on order' remains correct either way. Several on-order vessels named in Korean-yard coverage (Esteem Denali, Esteem Penguin, Venture Manatee, Hull 2575/2576, Atlantic Success, Hull 2393/2394/2395/2396, Hull 2693/2695) were checked and no independent delivery evidence either way was found for any of them within this pass's budget; their backend status is left as-is, unconfirmed either direction.
